{"people":[{"name":"Tom","role":"account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"product marketer, interviewer","side":"other"},{"name":"Angela","role":"COO at Marlowe & Finch; signed with Adyen","side":"customer"},{"name":"Raj","role":"CTO; ran the RFP; Tom's contact","side":"customer"},{"name":"Bev","role":"head of store operations","side":"customer"},{"name":"Unnamed ecommerce lead","role":"ecommerce lead; loved the online checkout demo","side":"customer"},{"name":"Unnamed solutions engineer","role":"solutions engineer who attended the store ops workshop","side":"us"}],
"competitors":["Adyen"],
"incumbent":null,
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"The store couldn't see the online order, so staff were refunding to gift cards or telling people to mail it back.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Core returns pain: stores had no view of online orders."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"they'd just launched a loyalty program that was supposed to work everywhere and didn't, because store and web were two different customer records.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Loyalty launch failed because of split customer records."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their COO, Angela, apparently stood in a store on December 27th watching the returns queue.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"Hearsay hedged with 'apparently'; the rep says everyone there tells this story."},
{"id":"E4","turn":4,"excerpt":"We proposed six hundred K a year. Stores and online together, one contract.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Deal size and structure: stores and online on one contract."},
{"id":"E5","turn":6,"excerpt":"He ran the RFP, he was my contact the whole way.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Basis for naming Raj as decider; only shows he ran the process."},
{"id":"E6","turn":8,"excerpt":"He said they came in with a retail team, people who'd done store rollouts, and they talked about one platform for the tills and the website, on one contract.","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (CTO), relayed by the rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","message"],"note":"Raj's account of the competitor pitch, told afterwards; rep wasn't there."},
{"id":"E7","turn":8,"excerpt":"And they named retailers Angela knew.","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (CTO), relayed by the rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor used references familiar to the COO."},
{"id":"E8","turn":10,"excerpt":"Before, it was all web. Conversion, checkout, wallets. After, it was stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Customer questions shifted from web to stores after meeting the competitor."},
{"id":"E9","turn":10,"excerpt":"Raj forwarded me a list of 14 questions and 11 of them were about stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","competitor"],"note":"Concrete count showing the shift toward store concerns."},
{"id":"E10","turn":12,"excerpt":"Reaction: the online checkout demo. Their ecommerce lead loved it.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Online checkout demo got a positive reaction."},
{"id":"E11","turn":12,"excerpt":"Silence: the unified commerce part.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The unified commerce pitch drew no reaction."},
{"id":"E12","turn":12,"excerpt":"Online and in-store on one platform, the line between them has pretty much disappeared.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Wording of our unified commerce slide."},
{"id":"E13","turn":12,"excerpt":"that's a diagram.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bev (head of store operations)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Bev dismissed the unified commerce slide."},
{"id":"E14","turn":12,"excerpt":"Then she asked how a return works. Step by step. At the till.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"Bev wanted a concrete till-level return walkthrough."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"I described it.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Rep described the return rather than showing it; very brief answer."},
{"id":"E16","turn":16,"excerpt":"Nobody on our side had run a store rollout.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Our team lacked store rollout experience at the workshop."},
{"id":"E17","turn":16,"excerpt":"When Bev asked who does the installs, I said we'd bring in a partner. She wrote something down and didn't ask another question.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"Partner-install answer was followed by Bev going quiet."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"I knew on the drive home.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's own read of when the deal was lost."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"Right before that, honestly, we were ahead. Raj said so.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep, citing Raj","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided","decider"],"note":"Raj told the rep we were ahead before the workshop."},
{"id":"E20","turn":16,"excerpt":"We'd won the web side.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep's claim that the web portion was won; unclear what actually moved."},
{"id":"E21","turn":16,"excerpt":"They had six people from store operations.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Large store ops presence versus our two attendees."},
{"id":"E22","turn":18,"excerpt":"Angela's team. Stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"The store ops workshop was requested by Angela's team."},
{"id":"E23","turn":20,"excerpt":"Angela.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Angela signed with Adyen."},
{"id":"E24","turn":22,"excerpt":"Probably Angela. Raj wanted us. I think. He told me he did.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Hedged shift from Raj to Angela as final decider."},
{"id":"E25","turn":24,"excerpt":"Once. The kickoff.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep met the actual signer only once."},
{"id":"E26","turn":26,"excerpt":"can I talk to them?","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Angela wanted a reference call with the case study retailer."},
{"id":"E27","turn":26,"excerpt":"we couldn't set up a call in time.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Reference call not arranged in time."},
{"id":"E28","turn":26,"excerpt":"Then a rollout plan. Dates, who installs, what happens to the old tills.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer requested a detailed rollout plan."},
{"id":"E29","turn":26,"excerpt":"They wanted to watch an online order get returned at a store till, live. We described it. We never showed it.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Live return demo requested and never delivered."},
{"id":"E30","turn":26,"excerpt":"Fashion retailer, stores and online, good story.","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"The case study sent was fashion retail, stores and online."},
{"id":"E31","turn":28,"excerpt":"\"One system for the tills and the website.\" That was Bev, every time.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bev (head of store operations)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Bev's repeated phrasing of the problem."},
{"id":"E32","turn":28,"excerpt":"Angela said, \"I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.\"","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decided"],"note":"Angela wants single-vendor accountability."},
{"id":"E33","turn":28,"excerpt":"And \"one customer, one basket.\"","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela (COO)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Angela's phrase for the unified customer record need."},
{"id":"E34","turn":28,"excerpt":"They never said \"unified commerce.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our category term never appeared in customer language."},
{"id":"E35","turn":28,"excerpt":"We kept saying \"in-person payments\" and \"point of sale.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our terms for the store side."},
{"id":"E36","turn":28,"excerpt":"They said \"the tills.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Customer's word for store checkout hardware."},
{"id":"E37","turn":30,"excerpt":"I think we had the better product online. I still think that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"the rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","message"],"note":"Rep's belief about online product superiority; contrasts with the lost store side."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E5","E23","E24"],"what":"Rep named CTO Raj as final decider and said he was the contact throughout, then said Angela signed and finally 'Probably Angela'."},
{"evidence":["E25","E23"],"what":"Rep met Angela only once at kickoff, yet she signed and her team drove the decisive workshop and requests."},
{"evidence":["E19","E11","E13"],"what":"Rep says we were ahead and had won the web side, yet the unified commerce pitch got silence and 'that's a diagram'."},
{"evidence":["E24","E19"],"what":"Rep says Raj wanted us and said we were ahead, but Raj did not decide and the deal went to the competitor."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What did you say?","turn":14,"what":"Answered only 'I described it' to Bev's request for a step-by-step till return, without detail."},
{"question":"So who made the final call?","turn":22,"what":"Opened with an ellipsis and hedged ('Probably', 'I think') after earlier naming Raj."},
{"question":"What did the customer bring up about the competitor?","turn":8,"what":"Answered only with Raj's after-the-fact account, stressing 'I wasn't there'; no first-hand observation."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"One system for the tills and the website","ours":"Online and in-store on one platform, the line between them has pretty much disappeared","evidence":["E31","E12"]},
{"theirs":"the tills","ours":"in-person payments / point of sale","evidence":["E36","E35"]},
{"theirs":"one customer, one basket","ours":"unified commerce","evidence":["E33","E34"]},
{"theirs":"I don't want two vendors pointing at each other","ours":"we'd bring in a partner","evidence":["E32","E17"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E23"],"what":"Lost: Angela signed with Adyen."},
{"evidence":["E4"],"what":"We proposed 600K a year covering stores and online in one contract."},
{"evidence":["E20","E19","E37"],"what":"Rep claims the web side was won and that we had the better online product; the transcript does not say any business moved to us."},
{"evidence":["E18","E17"],"what":"Rep felt the deal was lost at the store ops workshop after the partner-install answer."}
]}
